notes.title: Released the image "JOGO DE CADA ESTADO DO BRASIL" from the first season
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Finally, the complete image of the "JOGO DE CADA ESTADO DO BRASIL" is out, my two games are appearing as [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2177820/Pantazil/]Pantazil[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2763810/J_and_the_Sewer_World/]J and the Sewer World[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075496/c03b5b00d6d1f410c9165a63f36d609d42e9f2ee.png[/img]

And it doesn't stop there, this "JOGO DE CADA ESTADO DO BRASIL" is only the first season... And yes, there will be another season, in the second season another game of mine appeared, which is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3233190/EvolRUN/]EvolRUN[/url]. I'm very happy that my game EvolRUN is participating in the "JOGO DE CADA ESTADO DO BRASIL".
